specs.title: Purchase limit for one product

steps.title: 1. Open the product list and click `Add to Basket` on the product
2. Open the basket and click plus until the quantity is 5
3. Click the plus button one more time
4. Read the basket
5. Open the product list and click `Add to Basket` on the product

specs.title: Order with a card, from basket to order history

steps.title: 1. Add product A two times and product B one time from the product list
2. Open the basket
3. Click `Checkout`, select the saved address and click `Continue`
4. Select `One Day Delivery` and click `Continue`
5. Redeem the coupon of the current month
6. Select the saved card and click `Continue`
7. Click `Place your order and pay`
8. Read the order summary on the confirmation page
9. Read the basket counter and open the basket
10. Open `Orders & Payment`, then `Order History`

specs.title: Payment with the wallet

steps.title: 1. Open the basket, check out with the saved address
2. Select `Standard Delivery` and click `Continue`
3. Read the button `Pay`
4. Open `Orders & Payment`, then `Order History`
5. Open `Orders & Payment`, then `Digital Wallet`
Precondition: add 3.99 to the wallet with the saved card
6. Check out again with the saved address and `Standard Delivery`
7. Click the button `Pay`
8. Click `Place your order and pay`
9. Open `Orders & Payment`, then `Digital Wallet`
10. Open `Orders & Payment`, then `Order History`
